network: ctx.serve() responder behind the kernel's realm proxy (http_proxy/https_proxy, 127.0.0.1:3128); wasm-tls-engine lets the proxy terminate CONNECT with the kernel CA, which OpenSSL in php verifies through SSL_CERT_FILE. php -S and its clients use loopback directly (no_proxy).
checklist: cert/checklist.mjs: php -v is 'PHP 8.5.12 (cli) (built: Oct 19 2026 17:02:46) (NTS)', 'Built by homescoop', Zend Engine v4.5.12 and Zend OPcache (built: is main/php_version.h's mtime in the release tarball, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH); php -m lists exactly bcmath, calendar, Core, ctype, date, dom, exif, fileinfo, filter, hash, iconv, json, lexbor, libxml, mbstring, openssl, pcntl, pcre, PDO, pdo_sqlite, Phar, posix, random, Reflection, session, SimpleXML, SPL, sqlite3, standard, tokenizer, uri, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, Zend OPcache, zlib; PHP_OS WASI, PHP_OS_FAMILY Unknown, PHP_INT_SIZE 4; php_uname('s') is the kernel's wasi; php --ini names /etc/php and /etc/php/conf.d; php -i's Build System is homescoop's and its Configure Command names no build machine (no --build, no pkg-config paths); -r, a script with arguments, a script on stdin, -R and php -l; exit(7) is rc 7, fatal and parse errors rc 255 with PHP's messages; then json, pcre (with Unicode properties), mbstring, iconv, hash (sha256, crc32b, md5, hmac, xxh3), openssl (sha512, AES-256-CBC round trip, an EC P-256 key from an empty file in the config option, its signature verified), zlib, bcmath, date with Europe/Berlin DST, random (mt_srand(42)'s sequence), ctype, filter, tokenizer, calendar, posix, session, enums, readonly classes and 8.5's pipe operator and array_first/array_last

cert/openssl.mjs (homescoop#1690): with no settings, OPENSSL_CONF is the package's etc/openssl.cnf (slicc.commands.php.env), readable and with the shipped text; openssl_pkey_new() gives an RSA 2048 key (default_bits) and an EC prime256v1 key, and for each openssl_csr_new with a DN, openssl_csr_sign self-signed with serial 7 and sha256 (default_md: RSA-SHA256, ecdsa-with-SHA256), openssl_x509_parse's subject and issuer, openssl_x509_verify 1 and openssl_x509_check_private_key true; a caller's own OPENSSL_CONF wins, through kernel.run's env (default_bits 1024) and through bash, as a prefix assignment (1536) and exported (1024, seen by php's getenv); a caller's OPENSSL_CONF naming a missing file fails 'no such file'; the config option wins over the default (1536) and over a caller's OPENSSL_CONF (1024), and a missing one fails; a php started by shell_exec inherits the package's OPENSSL_CONF

cert/process.mjs: exec, shell_exec, system and passthru with exit statuses, popen both ways (pclose's status), proc_open in argv and shell form with three pipes, cwd and env; pcntl_fork (asyncify, proc_fork): the child's own pid and ppid, exit status 3 through pcntl_waitpid, a socketpair between parent and child, three children reaped with WNOHANG (11,12,13), a child that inherits a 3 MiB string, an object and an open file; pcntl_exec in a forked child (status 9); pcntl_async_signals handlers for USR1 and ALRM (pcntl_alarm cuts sleep(3) short), pcntl_signal_dispatch for a deferred USR2, SIG_IGN for TERM, a child killed with SIGKILL reported by pcntl_wtermsig; posix_getuid/getpwuid/getgrgid for root

cert/fibers.mjs (patches/0001, 0002): Fiber and the final FiberError class exist; Fiber::start throws FiberError 'Fibers are not available on this platform (WASIX can't switch stacks)', which a script catches and carries on (isStarted false, getCurrent null); generators (send, yield from, getReturn) work; uncaught, it is rc 255 with 'Fatal error: Uncaught FiberError', not a wasm trap

cert/bailout.mjs (patches/0003, zend_bailout over WASIX setjmp/longjmp; patches/0008): a fatal error from inside array_map 50 calls deep runs finally, flushes the output buffer, runs the shutdown function (which sees error_get_last) and exits 255; memory_limit 16M exhausted is a fatal error that still runs the shutdown function; set_time_limit(1) fires after a second of wall-clock time (patches/0008: ITIMER_REAL and SIGALRM, since WASIX has no ITIMER_PROF) with 'Maximum execution time of 1 second exceeded', rc 255 and the shutdown function; exit(4) from a closure inside array_map inside usort is rc 4 with the shutdown function; 2000 ErrorExceptions thrown from an error handler and 200 ParseErrors from eval are all caught

cert/stack.mjs (homescoop#1689, #1705, patches/0009): the nesting 8.5.12-1 handled works: 500 levels of serialize/unserialize (arrays and a linked list of objects), == on arrays and on objects with declared properties, json_encode/json_decode of arrays and objects, array_map, array_walk_recursive, count(COUNT_RECURSIVE), http_build_query and DOMDocument::saveXML; 200 of == on stdClass objects, var_dump (full output, no 'nesting level too deep'), __toString and preg_replace_callback; 300 of __get and ArrayAccess; 150 of usort; 50000 of plain PHP recursion (the VM's own stack) and a 1000-deep unserialize; zend.max_allowed_stack_size and zend.reserved_stack_size are 0 (detect); the issue's php -r of a 5000-deep serialize is rc 255 with PHP's 'Uncaught Error: Maximum call stack size of 2048000 bytes (zend.max_allowed_stack_size - zend.reserved_stack_size) reached. Infinite recursion?' and no RangeError; the same Error (or the path's own message), caught, from every checked path without an end: serialize and __serialize, array_map, array_filter, array_reduce, array_walk, usort, uasort, uksort and array_udiff callbacks, SplHeap::compare, __get, __set, __isset, __unset, __toString, a Stringable argument, preg_replace_callback, ArrayAccess offsetGet/offsetExists/offsetSet, __destruct, IteratorAggregate, ReflectionFunction::invoke, count(COUNT_RECURSIVE), array_walk_recursive, array_replace_recursive, compact, mb_convert_variables, http_build_query ('Maximum call stack size reached.'), == and === on arrays and == on stdClass objects ('Maximum call stack size reached during comparison'), == on objects with declared properties ('during object comparison'), DOMNode::isEqualNode and Dom\XMLDocument::saveXml, after which the script carries on (array_map over range(1, 100)) and the shutdown function runs; json_encode of 5000 levels is false with 'Maximum stack depth exceeded', var_dump and debug_zval_dump print 'nesting level too deep', a JsonSerializable without end and DOMDocument::normalize of 5000 levels throw; compiling 2000 nested calls or a 2000-deep constant array is rc 255 with 'reached during compilation' and no RangeError; uncaught, rc 255 with a stack trace; in a pcntl_fork child the same Error is caught and the child exits 3; -d zend.max_allowed_stack_size=256K lowers the limit (212992 bytes)

cert/memory.mjs (patches/0004, Zend MM chunks and huge blocks from a pool of aligned arenas): with memory_limit 512M a string grown by .= to 64 MiB has the right bytes; unset returns memory_get_usage to the baseline and memory_get_usage(true) drops; 5 rounds of range(1, 1000000), array_flip and a 40 MiB string keep the same peak; substr of a huge block (truncate), SplFixedArray(2000000); USE_ZEND_ALLOC=0 works

cert/tmp-phar.mjs (patches/0005): with no TMPDIR, sys_get_temp_dir() is /tmp and tempnam, tmpfile and php://temp past maxmemory work there; TMPDIR=/home/ and -d sys_temp_dir=/root still win; a Phar with a stub, a SHA-256 signature and a gzip-compressed entry is built with phar.readonly=0, runs as 'php app.phar world', is read through phar:// and extracted; a PharData tar is compressed to .tar.gz and read back

cert/fd.mjs (patches/0006): php://fd/1 and php://fd/2 reach stdout and stderr (file_put_contents and fopen); php://fd/-1 fails with 'The file descriptors must be non-negative numbers smaller than 2147483647'; a closed fd 77 fails. (fds from 3 up are the kernel's preopened directories in a WASI program, so a descriptor a shell opens for php isn't checked)

cert/http.mjs (patches/0007): http_proxy and https_proxy are the kernel's 127.0.0.1:3128; file_get_contents over http and https (CONNECT + TLS against the kernel CA) returns the body and HTTP/1.1 200 OK with the server's headers (http_get_last_response_headers); POST with a stream context sends the method, form body, headers and query; a 3-hop redirect is followed and max_redirects 1 stops it ('Redirection limit reached'); 404 is false with its status line, ignore_errors returns a 500's body; a 300000-byte binary body; OpenSSL verifies the kernel's certificate through SSL_CERT_FILE, a cafile with a decoy CA fails 'certificate verify failed' and verify_peer false accepts it. The patch's rules: no_proxy example.test, .test, a list with EXAMPLE.test, and * go direct (getaddrinfo for example.test fails), test.example, xample.test and 127.0.0.0/8 don't; a dead http_proxy (127.0.0.1:9) is Connection refused, as is a bare-host:port HTTPS_PROXY; HTTP_PROXY alone is ignored (httpoxy); all_proxy is used; a context proxy wins over the environment; a socks5:// proxy is ignored; loopback (php -S on 127.0.0.1) goes direct through the kernel's no_proxy

cert/server.mjs: php -S 127.0.0.1:18282 with a router script: JSON with $_GET (arrays), $_POST, REQUEST_METHOD and PHP_SAPI cli-server, custom headers; static files as text/plain; charset=UTF-8 and image/svg+xml; a 404 from the router; a PHPSESSID cookie counts visits 1, 2, 3 (session files in /tmp); four concurrent clients all answered; a raw HTTP/1.0 request over stream_socket_client; the server exits when killed

cert/heap.mjs (homescoop#1287, slicc-kernel#1172): php.wasm is a threaded bulk-memory module linked with recipe.yaml's wasm.initial-memory; 3 rounds, under SLICC_WASM_BACKTRACE=1, of hello, a 60000-record json_encode/json_decode, a shuffled and sorted range(1, 1000000) with array_flip, 200000 lines through preg_replace, 100000 PDO SQLite inserts, a 40000-element DOM with XPath, a fork child's str_replace over 8 MiB, and a 400000-entry array of arrays: rc 0, the right output, 0 wasm traps; VmSize (polled from /proc/<pid>/status) stays at the initial memory for all but the last, which grows past it through the allocator refresh

patches.patches/0001-configure-wasi-host.patch: configure on a wasi* host defines ZEND_FIBER_UNAVAILABLE instead of failing 'fibers not available on this platform', and sets PHP_OS WASI: cert/fibers.mjs, cert/checklist.mjs (PHP_OS); without it configure stops
patches.patches/0002-zend-fibers-unavailable-was: Fiber::start throws FiberError instead of linking boost.context's make_fcontext/jump_fcontext: cert/fibers.mjs; without it the link fails
patches.patches/0003-zend-setjmp-wasi.patch: SETJMP/LONGJMP are setjmp/longjmp in the caller's frame (the asyncify sysroot declares no sigsetjmp): cert/bailout.mjs's fatal errors, memory_limit, max_execution_time and exit(); without it ext/iconv and every zend_try fail to compile
patches.patches/0004-zend-alloc-chunks-wasi.patc: Zend MM chunks and huge blocks from a pool of 2 MiB-aligned arenas (posix_memalign), with free runs coalesced, huge blocks truncated and extended in place: cert/memory.mjs (huge-block growth and shrink, memory returned after unset, a steady peak) and cert/heap.mjs (VmSize stays near the heap PHP uses); without it every chunk's alignment slack leaks (wasi-libc's munmap takes only whole mappings), and with posix_memalign per chunk a 120 MiB heap grew the wasm memory to 252 MiB
patches.patches/0005-tmpdir-wasi.patch: P_tmpdir /tmp: cert/tmp-phar.mjs (sys_get_temp_dir, tempnam, tmpfile, Phar); without it sys_get_temp_dir() is '' and Phar fails 'unable to create temporary file'
php://fd/N without getdtablesize(): cert/fd.mjs; without it php_fopen_wrapper.c doesn't compile
patches.patches/0007-http-wrapper-env-proxy-wasi: http/https streams use http_proxy/https_proxy/all_proxy and honour no_proxy: cert/http.mjs; without it every remote http(s) URL fails 'getaddrinfo for example.test failed'
patches.patches/0008-max-execution-time-real-tim: max_execution_time arms ITIMER_REAL/SIGALRM, as upstream on Cygwin, PASE and Apple Silicon: cert/bailout.mjs's set_time_limit(1); without it setitimer(ITIMER_PROF) is EINVAL on WASIX and the limit never fires ('no timeout')
patches.patches/0009-zend-call-stack-wasi.patch: Zend's stack check on WASI: zend_call_stack_get() reports __stack_high and at most 2 MiB (2048000 bytes after zend.reserved_stack_size), and the C functions on each recursive path take a pad of shadow stack sized from that path's limit in V8 (execute_ex 3600 bytes for every call back into PHP, more for user sort callbacks, preg_replace_callback, SplHeap, __toString, getIterator, ArrayAccess, magic property methods and __destruct, and one for each recursion without a callback: serialize, json_encode, ==, var_dump, count, array_walk, compact, array_replace_recursive, http_build_query, mbstring, DOM, the compiler), so the check fires at about 65% of the depth the browser allows on every measured path (php_cv_have_stack_limit=yes in config.site turns ZEND_CHECK_STACK_LIMIT on; build.sh fails unless each of the 41 padded functions, or the function it is inlined into, takes at least its pad in php.wasm): cert/stack.mjs; without the check a 5000-deep serialize and infinite recursion through array_map end php with 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded' (rc 70), and with 8.5.12-2's single 2 KiB pad and 448 KiB budget json_encode of 500 levels is false and serialize, array_map and == of 500 levels throw
